title: feat: support multiple inputs in FFmpeg MCP
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Downloads public HTTPS sources into seekable container files named `input0`, `input1`, and so on
- Passes caller-supplied FFmpeg arguments directly, including positional `-i` options
- Accepts any safe single-file output extension and uploads the result to Pollinations Media
- Keeps Gen authentication, usage billing, and hosted resource links unchanged

Tests:
- `npm test` (8/8)
- `npm run check`
- Local two-input video + audio FFmpeg smoke test

gist.headline: Two inputs, one tiny movie
gist.blurb: The FFmpeg MCP tool can now bring video and audio to the same picnic. Hand it multiple public HTTPS files, add your FFmpeg flags, and it returns a freshly rendered result.
gist.summary: FFmpeg MCP now downloads multiple public HTTPS inputs as seekable `input0`, `input1`, and subsequent files, supports caller-provided positional `-i` arguments, and uploads any safe single-file output format to Pollinations Media.
gist.impact: Developers can combine separate video, audio, and other media sources in one MCP FFmpeg job while keeping the existing Gen authentication, billing, and hosted-result links.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed editing desk represents the FFmpeg MCP tool: two labeled media reels, one video and one audio, feed through a retro terminal into a single finished film reel. Polli acts as the cheerful editor, wearing tiny headphones and carefully connecting the two inputs, while a code-plant and small flowers make the technical workflow feel like a shared creative workspace.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene in a warm garden-shed media workshop where the cute Polli bee mascot, with a yellow body, dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular cheek blushes, a small happy smile, and rounded light blue translucent wings, wears tiny headphones while plugging two labeled reels, “VIDEO” and “AUDIO,” into a chunky retro FFmpeg terminal; the terminal produces one glowing finished film reel beside flowering code-plants.
